name: Window Zones
description:
Windows-style window management for GNOME.

* Double click a top or bottom resize border to maximize the window vertically only (left or right border: horizontally)
* Zone layouts like FancyZones: built-in layouts plus your own, made with a visual editor
* Hold Shift while dragging a window to drop it into a zone
* Drag a window to a screen corner to snap it to a quarter
* Snap Assist: after snapping, pick which window fills the remaining zones
* Keyboard shortcuts to move windows between zones, a layout picker and an always-on-top toggle
